scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@postkeeper/web && npm run build --workspace=@postkeeper/extension

scripts.pretest:extension: npm run build && npm run package:firefox --workspace=@postkeeper/extension
scripts.validate: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
